mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions with declining HOUST, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening cycle, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals reduced labor supply and rising wage pressures, which may lead to higher inflation and reduced corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during labor market tightening cycles with declining UNRATE, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary policy response to inflation, which increases the real cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
